title: mcctl server.yml
description: Generated by `mcctl schema` from mcctl/schema.py; mcctl validate is authoritative.

name.description: Deployment slug; derives bucket, Worker, tag and host names.

tailscale_login.description: Tailscale login name (ACL owner, panel admin).

email.description: Email allowed to log in to the admin panel (Cloudflare Access sends one-time codes here; not your Cloudflare account login). Required when panel.mode is cloudflare.

dns.description: Public DNS record for the server.

zone.description: Cloudflare zone (must exist in the account).

hostname.description: Record name for the server within the zone.

ttl.description: TTL of the A/AAAA records in seconds.

mail_hardening.description: The zone sends and receives no mail: Terraform adds a null MX (`MX 0 .`), `v=spf1 -all` and a `p=reject` DMARC record at the apex, so nobody can spoof mail from it. Set false if the zone has mail (the plan refuses while another MX record exists).

token_owner.description: Who owns the Cloudflare admin token: account (account-owned, recommended: it can't reach another account) or user. `mcctl init` sets it from the token; Terraform's R2 credential is owned the same way.

version.description: Minecraft version; needs server-config/keys/<version>/ in the product. Human-only change.

strict_whitelist.description: v1.3: players.yml is the whole whitelist: a deploy removes every live player it doesn't list. Default false: players who were never in players.yml (added on the console, through Discord, or a panel add that never reached Git) are kept and announced; removals from players.yml and the panel still apply.

gamerules.description: Game rules set over RCON in every dimension at each deploy (26.x names: snake_case, e.g. keep_inventory; checked against keys/<version>/gamerules.txt). locator_bar and players_sleeping_percentage are gameplay.* fields.

overrides.description: Escape hatch: <file>.<dotted.key>: value; every key must exist in keys/<version>/<file>.txt.

owner.description: Owner of the config repo. Default: from `git remote get-url origin`.

config_repo.description: Config repo name. Default: from `git remote get-url origin`.

oidc_subject.description: Format of the `sub` claim in the config repo's GitHub Actions OIDC tokens, which the tailnet's CI identity must match: `immutable` (`repo:OWNER@OWNER_ID/REPO@REPO_ID:...`, GitHub's default for repositories created, renamed or transferred since 2026-07-15, or opted in) or `legacy` (`repo:OWNER/REPO:...`, older repositories). Set by `mcctl setup` from the GitHub API; `mcctl doctor` checks it.

protect_main.description: Rulesets on the config repo: main only via pull requests with the required checks (needs GitHub Pro for a private personal repo; false = no ruleset, see SECURITY.md).

environments.description: GitHub Environments on the config repo (security review M2): the deploy secrets live in environment `deploy`, the updater App's key in `update`, both usable from main only, so a workflow pushed to another branch (update/*, panel/*) can't read them. The CI identity then trusts the `environment:deploy` OIDC subject. Needs the same paid plan as rulesets for a private personal repo. New config repos set it (template); false = repository-level secrets as before.

updater_app.description: Slug of the updater GitHub App: `server / gate` lets lock/product updates merge unattended only from its bot user (empty = they need the admin). Set by `mcctl setup`.

panel_app.description: Slug of the panel's GitHub App: `server / gate` lets whitelist changes merge unattended only from its bot user (empty = they need the admin). Set by `mcctl setup`.

bucket.description: R2 bucket holding the Terraform state. Default: <name>-tfstate.

key.description: Object key of the state file.

ipv4.description: Public IPv4 (null until the host exists).

ipv6.description: Public IPv6 from the host's prefix (null = IPv4 only).

resize_hint.default: a host with dedicated cores or more RAM

ssh_bootstrap_user.description: SSH user for the one-off bootstrap.

border_radius.description: World border per dimension, centred on 0,0.

overworld.description: Overworld border radius in blocks (null = none).

nether.description: Nether border radius in blocks (null = none).

end.description: End border radius in blocks (null = none; 3000 keeps the main island inside).

expected.description: true = a deploy fails rather than generate a new world when none exists.

active.description: v1.2 world library: the world on the server (the panel's Worlds tab switches it, then a PR).

library.description: v1.2: known worlds (the active one and the archived ones: restic snapshots tagged world:<name>); written by the panel, one canonical line per world.

name.description: World name (the panel's label and its restic tag world:<name>).

seed.description: Seed, a whole number in quotes ("" = random); used when the world is created.

type.description: World type when it is created (flat_*: superflat presets; single_biome: plains only).

preset.description: Server preset (difficulty, gamemode, force-gamemode, hardcore) written at each switch; null = leave server.properties as it is.

overworld.description: Overworld border radius in blocks (null = none).

nether.description: Nether border radius in blocks (null = none).

end.description: End border radius in blocks (null = none; 3000 keeps the main island inside).

pregen.description: Chunky pre-generation for this world (null = world.pregenerate.enabled; false = off for it).

enabled.description: v1.4: Chunky pre-generation while nobody is online (each bordered dimension up to its border, then the frontier). false = off for the whole deployment; a library world's pregen: false turns it off for that world alone.

frontier.description: v1.4: once the bordered passes are done (or for a dimension without a border), keep pre-generating `margin` blocks beyond the farthest generated chunk, so exploring rarely generates terrain under players.

margin.description: v1.4: blocks generated beyond the farthest generated chunk (view distance plus a few minutes of travel; elytra flights, 30-60 blocks/s, can outrun any margin).

max_radius.description: v1.4: hard cap (blocks from 0,0) for frontier expansion, for dimensions without a border above all; the world border is the real control of the world's size.

nerf_spawner_mobs.description: Spawner mobs have no AI (breaks most spawner farms).

locator_bar.description: v1.2: vanilla's Locator Bar (game rule locator_bar): other players' direction on the XP bar, for every player, no mod needed. Set over RCON in every dimension at each deploy.

sleeping_percentage.description: v1.2: share of online players who must sleep to skip the night (game rule players_sleeping_percentage; vanilla 100).

redstone.description: Redstone implementation (vanilla profile: VANILLA, every contraption behaves as in vanilla; balanced: ALTERNATE_CURRENT, faster but its update order differs). Default: performance.profile.

profile.description: Tuning profile. vanilla = every game mechanic exactly as in vanilla (mob caps, spawn rates, despawn ranges, activation ranges off, villager AI, item/XP merging, cramming, redstone, TNT); only optimisations no player can notice. balanced = the product's pre-1.x tuning (lower mob caps, activation ranges, faster item despawn, Alternate Current redstone): cheaper, but farms and some contraptions behave differently. Every field below that says 'Default: performance.profile' overrides its profile value on its own (docs/operations.md 'Performance profile').

view_distance.description: View distance in chunks (vanilla profile 10, balanced 8). Default: performance.profile.

simulation_distance.description: Simulation distance in chunks (<= view_distance; vanilla profile 8: the full 128-block mob spawning sphere, balanced 5). Default: performance.profile.

animals.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.animals (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

monsters.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.monsters (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

raiders.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.raiders (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

misc.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.misc (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

water.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.water (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

villagers.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.villagers (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

flying_monsters.description: spigot.yml entity-activation-range.flying-monsters (0 = always active, as in vanilla). Default: performance.profile.

soft.description: Monster soft despawn range in blocks (vanilla 32). Default: performance.profile.

hard.description: Monster hard despawn range in blocks (vanilla 128). Default: performance.profile.

players.description: spigot.yml entity-tracking-range.players in blocks: how far away players see them (visual only; capped by the view distance).

animals.description: spigot.yml entity-tracking-range.animals in blocks: how far away players see them (visual only; capped by the view distance).

monsters.description: spigot.yml entity-tracking-range.monsters in blocks: how far away players see them (visual only; capped by the view distance).

misc.description: spigot.yml entity-tracking-range.misc (items, XP orbs, item frames, paintings) in blocks: how far away players see them (visual only; capped by the view distance).

display.description: spigot.yml entity-tracking-range.display (text/block/item display entities) in blocks: how far away players see them (visual only; capped by the view distance).

other.description: spigot.yml entity-tracking-range.other in blocks: how far away players see them (visual only; capped by the view distance).

villager_search_radius.description: Villager POI search radius (vanilla profile 48 = Purpur's default, balanced 32). Default: performance.profile.

helper_cpus.description: P13: CPUs the product's helper services (agent, health, backup, ...) may use (systemd AllowedCPUs, e.g. '0'); null = all. The JVM keeps every CPU; helpers always run at idle CPU/IO priority.

cpu_affinity.description: P16: split = the product's helpers (agent, health, backup, prune, reboot gate) on CPU 0 and the JVM on CPUs 1..n-1 (systemd AllowedCPUs, from the host's CPU count at deploy; refused below 3 CPUs). off = the scheduler weights decide (today's behaviour).

chunk_threads.description: P16: paper-global.yml chunk-system.worker-threads (chunk generation/loading workers); auto = Paper's default (-1: half the cores, 1 on a 4-core box).

network_compression_threshold.description: P16: server.properties network-compression-threshold (packets of at least this many bytes are compressed; -1 = off).

noatime.description: P16: mount the filesystem holding the server directory with noatime (its /etc/fstab entry + a live remount). false leaves the mount untouched.

alt_item_despawn_ticks.description: Item id -> despawn ticks (20 ticks = 1 s); {} = off (vanilla profile: every item lasts 5 min; balanced: junk blocks 15-30 s). Replaces the whole map when set. Default: performance.profile.

heap_mb.description: Heap in MB, or auto = RAM - max(2816 (3584 with onserver/grafana), 30% of RAM), rounded down to 256 MB: the JVM's own memory outside the heap measured ~1.5 GB on an 8 GB box, plus the OS and the product's helpers (docs/reference.md 'Design notes').

gc.description: P16: garbage collector. zgc = Generational ZGC (Java 25: sub-millisecond pauses, ~15% more CPU, less native memory than G1); g1 = Aikar's G1 flags (55-65 ms pause ticks in every bench).

bucket.description: R2 bucket for restic backups. Default: <name>-mc-backups.

lock_days.description: R2 bucket lock on snapshots/ and data/ (keep_within = lock + 1).

source.description: Where the lock tool resolves it.

emails.description: Emails allowed through Cloudflare Access (>= 1 in cloudflare mode). Default: [admin.email].

idp.description: Access login method (github needs an OAuth app).

github_client_id.description: GitHub OAuth app client id (idp github; its secret goes in TF_VAR_panel_github_client_secret).

reauth_minutes.description: Session length of the confirmation host's Access app (one-time PIN): destructive actions need a confirmation login younger than this.

implementation.description: v1.4: which mc-agent runs on the box (panel mode cloudflare) and answers mcctl's actions: rust (smallworld-agent, the port; the default since v1.4.0) or python (scripts/mc_agent.py, the supported fallback). Either runs the experience telemetry in-process. Both read and write the same state, so switching either way is a deploy.

retention_days.description: Metric retention in D1 (5-min rollups after 7 days).

d1_days.description: Days of searchable logs in D1.

r2_days.description: Days of raw journal archives in R2.

max_rows_per_day.description: Cap on log rows written to D1 per day.

grafana.description: On-server Grafana add-on (costs ~768 MB of heap).

mspt_checks.description: ... for this many checks in a row.

heap_pct.description: Post-GC heap percentage that triggers the resize hint ...

heap_checks.description: ... for this many checks in a row.

gc_pause_ms.description: Alert on server freezes from Java memory management longer than this (G1 pauses; ZGC allocation stalls, ZGC's own pauses are sub-millisecond). 50 ms = one tick's budget.

repeat_hours.description: health.py alerts: one message when a problem starts, then at most one reminder per this many hours while it lasts (with the occurrences in between), one when it clears.

disk_pct.description: Alert when the server filesystem is this full.

steal_pct.description: Alert when CPU steal exceeds this ...

steal_checks.description: ... for this many checks in a row.

chunk_entities.description: Panel + Discord: a loaded chunk with at least this many entities is flagged (Experience tab 'Busiest chunks'; one alert per chunk, again after 6 h if still heavy); 0 = off.

backup_period_minutes.description: Watchdog: expected interval between backups (match backups.schedule); alerts after it + 30 min.

enabled.description: P13 player-experience analytics: the in-house mc-telemetry plugin (/lag) and, in cloudflare mode, mc-agent shipping its snapshots to the Worker (verdicts, history, in-game messages).

plugin_budget_us.description: The plugin's main-thread budget per tick in microseconds (self-measured).

enabled.description: Private in-game messages telling a player why they lagged and what helps.

per_player_minutes.description: At most one message per player per this many minutes.

broadcast_minutes.description: Server-wide lag: at most one short broadcast per this many minutes.

per_hour.description: At most this many messages per hour in all.

join_summary.description: On join, a short note if the player's last session lagged.

hour_days.description: Hourly rollups in D1 (R2 keeps the raw archive forever).

segment_days.description: Days of compressed segments kept on the box (redundancy, backfill).

segment_cap_mb.description: Disk cap of the box's segments (oldest dropped first).

backfill_window.description: Extra local-time window (HH:MM-HH:MM) when undelivered data may be backfilled even if the server isn't idle-healthy; never while players are online. null = only when nobody is online.

branding.description: Server name, colours, MOTD, icon, greetings, rules (P17).

enabled.description: P17: the in-house mc-brand plugin (join greeting, /rules, /discord, server links, tab list, /hud, the optional drink) and the server-list icon. false = none of it (the MOTD stays minecraft.motd).

name.description: The server's name in titles, the tab list, the sidebar and the panel. Default: minecraft.motd without formatting codes.

accent.description: Accent (the server name, player names, links): #RRGGBB.

motd.description: Server-list message, up to 2 lines; '&' or '§' + 0-9/a-f/k-o/r are Minecraft's 16 colours and styles (the pinned server's MOTD has no hex colours). Empty = minecraft.motd.

icon.description: A 64x64 PNG in this config repo (path relative to it) for the server list; null = the product's icon.

rules.description: /rules, numbered (<= 20). Keep them short and friendly. {glyph} in a rule or a greeting is the resource pack's glyph (resource_pack.glyph) for players who have the pack, nothing for the rest.
default: No cheats or hacked clients (visual mods are fine).

discord_invite.description: Discord invite (https://discord.gg/...): /discord and the pause menu's server links.

rules_url.description: A web page with the rules (server links).

title.description: Show a title (the server name) and a subtitle on join.

first_join.description: Chat greeting on a player's first join. Placeholders: {player}, {server}, {glyph}.
first_join.default: Welcome to {server}, {player}! Make yourself at home.

welcome_back.description: Chat greeting on later joins. Placeholders: {player}, {server}, {ago} (e.g. '3 days'), {glyph}.

sound.description: Sound event played to the joining player (a vanilla sound event id); null = none.

hud.description: The HUD (top bar or sidebar) and the tab list.

enabled.description: Players may choose a HUD with /hud top|side|off: a one-line boss bar at the top (server health, speed, tick time, their connection) or the sidebar (players + ping as well).

default_mode.description: v1.0.1: the HUD of players who never used /hud: top (boss bar), side (sidebar) or off. Default: side if default_on is true, else top.

default_on.description: Before v1.0.1: true = the sidebar for players who never used /hud (default_mode wins).

max_players.description: Player names shown in the sidebar (then '+N more').

tab_list.description: Branded tab list header and footer (players online, TPS).

settle_seconds.description: v1.1: a player who just joined sees 'Settling in…' instead of the server's health (their ping and the chunks around them are still loading) for at least this long and until their ping reads steady.

drink.description: The signature drink item (off by default).

enabled.description: The signature drink: a never-empty potion item (one per player, /<command>) that gives a short Nausea; cosmetic only.

command.description: v1.2: the command that hands out the drink (/<command>), 3-16 lowercase letters; not one of mc-brand's own (rules, discord, hud, mcbrand, modpack, view, compass, map, help, commands).

texture.description: v1.2: the drink's item texture in the resource pack: a 16x16 PNG (<= 8 KB) in this config repo (path relative to it), used byte for byte; null = the product's neutral art.

color.description: Potion colour (shown without the resource pack): #RRGGBB.

give_on_first_join.description: Every player who never had the drink gets one when they join (v1.0.1: not only on the first join, so players from before the drink get theirs).

resource_pack.description: The optional server resource pack (the drink's texture, the glyph).

enabled.description: Offer a small resource pack on join (the drink's texture, the {glyph} icon and the server icon: this config repo's own PNGs byte for byte, else the product's neutral art; built by `mcctl render`, optional for players, served by the watchdog Worker at hb.<hostname>.<zone>/pack/<sha1>.zip). Run `mcctl apply` once after turning it on or changing its art (Terraform uploads the pack).

prompt.description: Text on the client's download prompt.

description.description: v1.2: the pack's description (pack.mcmeta; shown in the client's resource pack list).
description.default: Item textures for this server's mc-brand plugin

glyph.description: v1.2: the {glyph} icon in chat texts: an 8x8 PNG (<= 8 KB) in this config repo (path relative to it), used byte for byte; null = the product's neutral glyph. Players without the pack see no glyph.

holograms.description: v1.2: floating texts (e.g. at spawn), text display entities for vanilla clients; at most 10.

x.description: Block x: the text floats over the block's centre (x, y and z, or `at: spawn`).

y.description: Block y (the text's centre is half a block above it).

at.description: v1.3: `spawn` instead of x/y/z: 3 blocks above the dimension's world spawn (found when the hologram spawns; it follows /setworldspawn).

lines.description: The text, one entry per line (<= 8). Placeholders: {server}, {players} (online now), {tps}, {glyph} (the resource pack's glyph, only for players with the pack).

health.description: Add a live line with the server's health word (Smooth / A bit busy / Laggy).

help.description: v1.3: append the list of commands every player may use (the same list as /help: built from the enabled features, never out of sync).

compass.description: v1.3: the friend compass (a boss bar).

enabled.description: v1.3: the friend compass, a boss bar that turns with the player: cardinal points and online players' names at their bearing; the one faced shows the distance and up/down arrows; players in other dimensions as 'name (Nether)'. /compass on|off|hide|show|auto. false = no compass and no /compass.

default_on.description: v1.3: shown without /compass on, except for clients with both the Smallworld mod and Xaero's maps (their friends are on Xaero's maps). false = only for players who type /compass on.

max_range.description: v1.3: players farther away (blocks, horizontally) aren't on the compass.

distance_rounding.description: v1.3: the faced player's distance is rounded to a multiple of this (blocks).

height_threshold.description: v1.3: up/down arrows when a player is more than this many blocks above/below.

enabled.description: v1.3: /map gives each player a personal map item that re-centres on them while held (the off hand makes it a minimap), with every online player as a named cursor; /map zoom cycles the scale. Terrain fills in as the player explores (vanilla's map rendering). Free to re-get, can't be copied. Players without client mods get a one-line tip at join.

prerender.description: v1.4: show the nightly pre-rendered terrain (map.enabled) where the player hasn't been yet; vanilla's live colours take over where they have. Never in the Nether.

map_room.description: v1.4: the spawn map room, a wall of pre-rendered maps.

enabled.description: v1.4: a wall of item frames with maps of the pre-rendered world (map.enabled) at spawn, refreshed after each nightly render. The frames are fixed and invulnerable, their maps can't be taken; changing this section moves the wall (the old frames are removed), false removes it. It places entities in the live world: build a wall behind it first if you want one (fixed frames also hang in the air).

at.description: `spawn`: the wall's bottom centre is the dimension's world spawn + offset (found when the plugin starts). Else give x, y and z.

offset.description: With at: spawn: [x, y, z] blocks from the spawn block to the wall's bottom centre frame.

x.description: Block x of the wall's bottom centre frame.

y.description: Block y of the wall's bottom row.

z.description: Block z of the wall's bottom centre frame.

facing.description: The way the maps face (towards the viewer): south = seen by a player looking north.

view.description: border: the whole world border (centred on 0,0) fitted to the wall; spawn: the vanilla map grid at `scale` around the spawn, one map per frame.

scale.description: With view: spawn, blocks per pixel = 2^scale (0..4).

cursors.description: Show online players in that dimension as cursors on the wall.

max_connections_per_source.description: Concurrent Minecraft connections per source (IPv4 address, IPv6 /64). Players behind one address (CGNAT, a LAN party, a school) share it: raise it for them.

client.description: v1.1: the client modpack, its setup page, /view.

enabled.description: v1.1: the optional client modpack (Fabric + Sodium & co., four tiers, client/pack.yml) and its setup page at <hostname>.<zone>, opened with a one-time code from /modpack in game. Needs panel.mode cloudflare and branding.enabled, and a client.lock.yml (`mcctl config set client.enabled true` writes the first one; or `mcctl lock update --client`). Run `mcctl apply` once after turning it on (the Worker's client bindings, the page's host, the artifact mirror): a deploy alone isn't enough.

hostname.description: The setup page's record name: <hostname>.<zone> (e.g. play.example.com).

prompt.description: Remind players without the pack at every join, with a click to /modpack (v1.2: exact, the pack's client mod says hello; players with an outdated pack are told so). Each player can switch the reminder off with /modpack off.

tiers.description: The tiers offered on the setup page (Low, Medium, High, Maximum; Medium is recommended).

enabled.description: v1.1: /view <n>: every player may raise their own view distance up to `max` chunks (mc-brand). Only while the server's health is Smooth; lowered back to the server's view distance automatically when it isn't, and raised again once it is. Lowering is always allowed. Kept per player (UUID).

max.description: Highest /view a player may ask for (chunks).

check_seconds.description: How often mc-brand checks the server's health for raised view distances.

fps.description: v1.2: the client mod's FPS reports and FPS display.

interval_seconds.description: v1.2: how often the Smallworld client mod reports the player's FPS (smallworld:fps; the Experience tab's 'server fine / your PC' diagnosis). Sent to the mod at every join (smallworld:config).

hud.description: v1.2: the client mod draws the FPS next to the top HUD bar (each player can still hide it in config/smallworld.json). v1.4.1: for a player whose in-game HUD shows (/hud top or side), mc-brand puts the reported FPS inside that HUD and tells the mod not to draw its own, whatever this says; this applies only to players with /hud off or with branding.hud switched off.

map.description: v1.2: Xaero's maps in the pack (server side, mc-brand).

players.description: v1.2: every online player shows on the others' Xaero's Minimap and World Map at any distance in the same dimension (mc-brand speaks Xaero's own tracked-player channel; spectators and invisible players are left out).

fair_play.description: v1.2: Xaero's fair-play mode for everyone with the mod: no cave map, no entity radar (the players above still show).

commands.description: Discord slash commands on the watchdog Worker (P14; panel.mode cloudflare): /status /players /lag /perf /backups /whitelist /rejected, and /backup now, /whitelist add. `mcctl setup` fills the ids.

public_key.description: The application's public key (hex; public: it only verifies Discord's signatures).

guild_id.description: The one Discord server (guild) the commands work in.

channel_ids.description: Channels the commands work in (>= 1 with commands).

user_ids.description: Discord users allowed to use them (>= 1 with commands).

helper_user_ids.description: Helpers (v1.0.1): Discord users who may run the read commands, /whitelist list and /whitelist add (not /backup now), in the same channels.

helper_role_id.description: Helpers by role: members of the guild with this role id have the helper commands.

ephemeral.description: Replies only the caller sees (Discord's ephemeral messages).

update_day.description: Day of the weekly update + deploy slot (04:17 UTC; the config repo's workflow schedule).

reboot_window.description: Window for automatic reboots, HH:MM-HH:MM local time.

map.description: v1.4: the world map pre-render (pocket map, map room).

enabled.description: v1.4: the nightly world map pre-render (smallworld-map, its own user, no network, read-only on the world): tiles of the exact colours vanilla maps draw, for the pocket map (branding.pocket_map.prerender) and the spawn map room (branding.map_room). false = no timer, and the output is removed.

schedule.description: When it runs (systemd OnCalendar, host time zone; Persistent, up to 10 minutes' random delay). Pick quiet hours away from maintenance.window: a run reads only what changed since the last one.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to render. Never the Nether (vanilla draws Nether maps as noise).

radius.description: Render chunks within this many blocks of 0,0 (a square); null = each dimension's world border (the active world's, else world.border_radius; no border = everything generated).

threads.description: Worker threads. The render runs at idle priority (it only gets CPU the server doesn't use); more threads only shorten the first full render.

maintenance.description: v1.3: the window in which deploys may restart Minecraft.

window.description: v1.3: when a deploy may restart Minecraft, HH:MM-HH:MM in `timezone` (may cross midnight, e.g. 23:00-01:00). A deploy outside it applies the files and leaves the restart pending: a timer restarts the server inside the window (see force_after_minutes_before_end; any earlier restart applies it too), and Discord says so. A forced deploy (`mcctl deploy --force-restart`, the workflow's force_restart) restarts at once. null = a deploy restarts whenever it needs to.

timezone.description: Time zone of the window (zoneinfo name); null = host.timezone.

force_after_minutes_before_end.description: Inside the window a pending restart waits for an empty server (RCON `list`; unknown counts as occupied); in the window's last this-many minutes it restarts anyway, with the in-game countdown. Shorter than the window; 0 = never forced (the next window tries again).

enabled.description: Pushes to main deploy (mcctl flips it after bootstrap).
